text: Nice try! Let's pop more next time.
Listen, and build the castle, room by room!
Listen to the whole sentence. Which room is it?
Drag each sticker into the right room.
Listen. Where is Wim? Tap the room.
Look at the picture. Listen. True or false?
Look and listen. Build the sentence.
Listen to the word. Which sound do you hear?
Build my tongue twister before the sand runs out!
Now say it slow, faster, and at magic speed!
Reed the spell book. Then answer the questions.
Tap the chest to open it!
Amazing! You are a sound wizard!
Number one. Cat-cat is playing in the living room.
Number two. Wim is cooking in the kitchen.
Number three. Pip is sleeping in the bedroom.
Number four. Cat-cat is having a bath in the bathroom.
Number five. Wim is eating in the dining room.
Number six. Pip is walking in the hallway.
There is a chair in the kitchen.
There is a bed in the bedroom.
There is a table in the kitchen.
There is a lamp in the bedroom.
There is a pot in the kitchen.
Wim is in the dining room.
Wim is in the living room.
There is no chair in the kitchen.
There is a bed in the kitchen.
The chair is in the kitchen.
The bed is in the bedroom.
Cat-cat is in the dining room.
Wim’s chick chews cheese chips on a chair.
Wim has a chest in the kitchen.
In the chest, there is a chick.
The chick is on a chair.
Now there is cheese on the table.
Listen to the word. Which sound do you hear?
Remember the castle? Listen. Where is Cat-cat? Tap the room.
Cat-cat is in the living room.
Listen, and build Cat-cat’s bedroom, piece by piece!
Listen to the whole sentence. Which piece is it?
Number one. There is a big window in the bedroom.
Number two. There is a little lamp by the bed.
Number three. There is a wooden door in the bedroom.
Number four. There is a red bed in the bedroom.
Listen to the riddle. What is it? Tap the picture.
You can look out of it.
You open it and walk in.
There is no lamp in the bedroom.
There is no window in the bedroom.
There is a table in the bedroom.
There is a door in the bedroom.
The lamp is by the bed.
Listen. Does it start with l, or w?
Wim’s little lamp wobbles by the window.
Reed the story. Then answer the questions.
There is a big bed and a window.
There is a lamp by the bed.
At night, the lamp is on.
Wim looks in the window and waves.
Amazing! You found everything in the bedroom. You are an L and W wizard!
Listen. Where is it? Tap the room.
Listen, and build Wim’s sitting room, piece by piece!
You look in it and see you!
One person sits in it. It is soft.
Two or three people sit on it.
Listen. Where is Wim’s lamp? Tap the right picture.
The lamp is under the table.
The lamp is behind the bed.
The lamp is in the bath.
The lamp is next to the sofa.
The lamp is on the chair.
The lamp is next to the bath.
The armchair is next to the sofa.
The lamp is on the bed.
The clock is under the sofa.
Wim has a new sitting room.
There is a sofa and an armchair.
Wim’s lamp is behind the clock!
Hooray! You found the lamp and everything in the castle. You are a where-is-it wizard!
Listen, and build the carnival, stand by stand!
Listen to the whole sentence. Which stand is it?
Number one. It's red at the balloon stand.
Number two. It's blue at the cotton candy stand.
Number three. It's yellow at the popcorn stand.
Listen. Where is Pip? Tap the stand.
Pip is at the balloon stand.
Pip is at the cotton candy stand.
Pip is at the popcorn stand.
Drag each prize to the right color!
Listen. Is it R, Y, or B?
Tap the crate to open it!
Amazing! You are a Color Carnival champion!
Listen. Is it hello, or goodbye?
Listen to the name. Tap the friend!
Look and listen. True or false?
Listen to the word. Which sound does it start with?
Tap the party box to open it!
You did it! Hello, party star! Bye-bye!
Hi, hi, hi! I am Pip!
I lost my friends in the forest. Will you help me find them?
Hello! I am Bella. Nice to meet you!
Nice to meet you! I am Bella.
Perfect ears! You popped the sounds!
Hello, my name is Pip. Nice to meet you.
Hello, my name is Mia. Nice to meet you.
Hello, my name is Bella. Nice to meet you.
Yay! Me too! I am happy!
That is okay. I am with you.
It's okay to feel sad. I am here.
You did it! You made three new friends! Hello, hello, hello!
To open a booth, ask: What is your name?
Then listen: My name is Bella!
Perfect ears! You popped the sounds!
You did it! You met Willow! What is your name? My name is Willow!
How are you? How are you?
I am happy — yes I am! Ha ha ha!
I am sad — boo hoo hoo.
I am angry — grrr grrr grrr!
Every feeling is okay with you!
Mia is happy. Feed the happy monster!
Bella is sad. Feed the sad monster!
Leo is angry. Feed the angry monster!
Pip is happy. Feed the happy monster!
Leo is sad. Feed the sad monster!
Bella is angry. Feed the angry monster!
Perfect ears! You popped the sounds!
Mia is sad. She is sad.
Pip is happy. He is happy.
Bella is happy. She is happy.
Leo is angry. He is angry.
Mia is happy. She is happy.
Leo is sad. He is sad.
And you, Leo? How are you?
You did it! You met Leo and shared your feelings! How are you? I am happy!
Hello, friends! Today is Bella’s birthday!
Hello! I am Bella. I am five!
Hi! I am Mia. I am six!
Hi! I am Leo. I am seven!
Hello! I am Willow. I am four!
Hi friends! I am Pip. I am six!
I am five! Tap five candles on my cake!
I am six! Tap six candles for Mia!
I am six too! Give Pip six candles!
Your turn! How old are you? Tap your age, then put candles on your cake and blow!
Perfect ears! You popped the sounds!
I am happy. How are you?
My name is Pip. What is your name?
Nice to meet you! How old are you?
I am six. How old are you?
We are so happy you are here!
You did it! You know my age! Goodbye, friend! See you next lesson!
Oh no! Leo lost his lucky star. He feels sad.
Let’s ask Leo how he feels, and help him find it!
I am sad. I lost my star.
Do not worry! We will help you!
Nice to meet you again! Leo lost his star — will you help?
My name is Bella. Let’s go help Leo find his star.
I am happy! Do not worry, Leo — we will find it.
I am angry we cannot find it. Let’s keep looking!
My star! You found it! I am so happy now!
Thank you, friends! How are you?
Wait! I see some of my things. Reed them with me!
One more thing! Keep reading with me!
I am happy! Do not worry, Leo.
I am angry we cannot find it.
I lost my star. I was sad.
We said hello and asked how to help.
We looked together in the meadow.
I felt a little angry, but we did not give up!
We found the star! Now Leo is happy!
Yay! Just like Leo when he found his star!
That is okay. Feelings can change, just like in the story.
It's okay to feel sad, like Leo did at first. It gets better!
Thank you for helping me find my star — and you reed hat, mat, and bat all by yourself! Tonight, find a hat at home and reed it out loud!
Trophy day! Show us everything you know!
Sounds, names, feelings — you can do it all!
Me too! We are all friends!
Leo is happy. He is happy.
Bella is sad. She is sad.
Pip is angry. He is angry.
Yay! You should feel proud and happy!
That is okay. You worked hard and did great!
It's okay. You still earned this trophy — great job!
Pip is walking in the forest. Who will Pip meet today?
"Hello! My name is Pip!" "Hello! My name is Mia!" Mia is happy. Pip and Mia play together.
"Hello! My name is Bella." But Bella is sad. "What is wrong?" asks Pip. They help Bella. "Thank you! Now I am happy!"
"Hello! My name is Leo." But Leo is angry! "Why are you angry?" asks Pip. Leo tells them his problem. They help Leo. "Thank you, friends! Now I am happy!"
Now everyone is happy together! Pip, Mia, Bella, Leo, and Willow are all friends!
You did it! You earned the Unit 1 Trophy! Hello, names, feelings, and all 8 letter sounds — you know it all! Tonight, say hello to your family, tell them your age, and show them how you feel!
Look! Bella has a red balloon, Willow has blue cotton candy, and I have yellow popcorn!
Wonderful! The balloon is red. The cotton candy is blue. The popcorn is yellow.
Yes! The cotton candy is blue!
Bella found a big red balloon at the carnival!
Then Willow got some blue cotton candy.
Red, blue, yellow — what a colorful day at the carnival!
You did it! You can name red, blue, and yellow at the Color Carnival!
Willow has a green leaf, Leo found an orange, and Mia has purple grapes!
Wonderful! The leaf is green. The orange is orange. The grapes is purple.
Willow found a big green leaf on a bush!
Then Leo found a bright orange orange on a tree.
Mia found a bunch of purple grapes too!
Green, orange, purple — so many colors with friends!
You did it! You can name green, orange, and purple!
Look! Today we find shapes, not colors!
Bella has a round ball, Mia has square books, and Leo has a triangle pizza!
Wonderful! The ball is a circle. The book is a square. The pizza is a triangle.
What color and shape is the ball?
What color and shape is the pizza?
Bella found a round red ball. It is a red circle!
Then Mia found a blue square book.
Leo found a yellow triangle pizza too!
Red circle, blue square, yellow triangle — so many shapes with friends!
You did it! You can name red circles, blue squares, and yellow triangles!
Red, blue, yellow, green, orange, purple — six colors!
Let’s see how many you remember!
What color and shape is the ball?
Bella and Pip found a red apple.
Then they saw blue water flowing by.
They found a yellow sunflower too!
Red, blue, yellow, green, orange, purple — I remember them all!
Amazing! You remember red, blue, yellow, green, orange, and purple — plus red circles, blue squares, and yellow triangles!
Look, Bella! There is a little fish in the pond!
Oh! But this fish has no color at all!
Once there was a little fish with no color at all. It felt very sad.
The fish swam by a red flower. Its scales turned red! "It's red!" said the fish.
Next, it swam by an orange flower. Its scales turned orange too! "It's orange!"
Then it swam by a yellow flower. Its scales turned yellow! "It's yellow!"
It swam by a green lily pad. Its scales turned green! "It's green!"
It swam by a blue flower. Its scales turned blue! "It's blue!"
Last, it swam by a purple flower. Its scales turned purple! "It's purple!"
Now the little fish has every color — red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and purple! "You are a rainbow fish!" said Pip and Bella.
What color was the fish at the start?
What color is the fish now?
Do you like the rainbow fish?
You did it! You know the whole rainbow — red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and purple!
Six colors, three shapes — we learned so much in the Rainbow Meadow!
Let's go on one big hunt and find them all, one more time!
We started with red, blue, and yellow.
Then we found green, orange, and purple!
Next we learned circles, squares, and triangles.
And we put colors and shapes together — like a yellow triangle!
We even met a little fish who found every color in the whole rainbow!
You are a Rainbow Meadow champion! Six colors, three shapes, and you can put them together — red circles, blue squares, yellow triangles, and everything in between!
Today it's toys — let's go and see!
Look! Today we find toys, not colors or shapes!
Bella has a red ball, Willow has a blue car, and Mia has a green doll!
Wonderful! It's a red ball. It's a blue car. It's a green doll.
What color and toy is this?
What color and toy is this?
Bella found her favorite toy. It is a red ball!
Willow zoomed her toy car. It is a blue car!
Mia hugged her soft doll. It is a green doll!
Red ball, blue car, green doll — so many toys with friends!
You did it! You can name a red ball, a blue car, and a green doll!
Look! More toys today — a teddy bear, blocks, and a train!
Leo has one teddy bear. But Bella has many blocks — they are blocks!
Wonderful! It's a brown teddy bear. They are blue blocks. It's a red train.
Amazing! One or many, you know them all!
Choo choo! One car is empty. Which toy is missing?
Is it one block, or many blocks?
What color and toy is this?
Leo has one toy. It is a brown teddy bear!
Bella has many toys. They are blue blocks!
Willow has one toy. It is a red train!
One teddy bear, one train, but many blocks — playtime is the best with friends!
You did it! You know one teddy bear, one train, and many blocks!
Hello! Remember our toys — ball, car, doll?
Today it's something new — Pip's family!
Welcome to my home! Today you meet my family!
Let's meet them one at a time!
Pip woke up at home. Mom and Dad were making breakfast!
This is my mom. She makes yummy pancakes!
This is my dad. He reads me a story every night!
I love my mom and my dad. We are a happy family!
Hi, Pip's mom! Nice to meet you!
Hi, Pip's dad! Nice to meet you!
You did it! You can say "This is my mom!" and "This is my dad!"
Hi! My name’s Pip. What’s your name?
Hi! I’m Leo. What’s your name?
Pip comes in. What does he say?
Pip goes home. What does he say?
It’s a party! New friends are at the door.
Say hello and ask their names. Then the door opens!
Great! Now say: My name is…
You said hello, asked names, and made your own name badge! Bye-bye!
Welcome back, class! Let’s remember what we learned.
Hello! My name is Pip. I am 7 years old!
Great job! Today we learn something new.
How are you today? I am fine, thank you!
I am happy! How are you?
I am happy you are here!
This is Pip. Pip is a boy. He is a boy!
This is Mia. Tap Mia — She is a girl!
Leo is a boy. We say...
Bella is a girl. We say...
Look at Pip! He is happy.
Look at Mia! She is sad.
Look at Leo and Willow! They are tired and hungry.
Yes! They are tired and hungry!
Yes! They are happy and sad!
Point to a friend. Is your friend a boy or a girl?
Pip feels tired today. "I am so tired!"
Pip rests, then plays with his friends.
Look! The book is in the bag.
Look! The apple is on the desk.
Look! The chair is next to the desk.
You said how you feel, and read three more real words — sit, pin, and pip!
Welcome back, class! Today we play a listening game.
Listen carefully to each friend, then choose the right answer!
I love listening games! Let’s go!
I carry my books in my bag.
You listened carefully to hello, names, ages, feelings, friends, and your teacher — great job!
Welcome back, class! Today we practice something new.
You will meet a partner and have a real conversation!
I love talking to my friends! Let’s go!
Watch me! Hello! My name is Miss Marigold. Nice to meet you!
Hi Pip! My name is Leo.
Nice to meet you too! How are you today?
Nice to meet you! How are you?
Wonderful! You had a real conversation!
Hello! Nice to meet you too!
Now you try! Point to a friend and introduce them!
You met a partner, had a real conversation, and learned a new sound — F is for friend, and F is for Fox, just like me!
Hi! I am Pip. Let me show you my whole day!
From waking up... all the way to going to sleep. Ready?
Every morning, I wake up! Good morning!
Every morning, I brush my teeth!
I am hungry! So I eat my breakfast. Yum, yum!
I put on my backpack, and I walk to school!
Good morning, Pip! How are you?
I am happy! I am ready to learn.
After playing, I am thirsty! I drink some water.
Look at Pip. He is happy!
Look at Mia. She is happy too!
Look at Pip, Mia, and Leo. They are happy!
Pip and Mia are playing together. … are happy.
Look at Mia on the slide!
Now look at Leo on the swing!
Now look at all three of us together!
Look at Pip at breakfast. How does he feel?
Look at Pip after playing. How does he feel?
Look at Pip, Mia, and Leo together. How do they feel?
At night, I reed my favorite book.
Then I close my eyes. I sleep. Good night!
What do you do in the morning, Pip?
I wake up. I brush my teeth. Then I eat breakfast.
What do you do at recess?
I play! I run and slide.
What do you do at night?
I reed a book. Then I sleep.
What do you do in the morning?
What do you do at recess?
Great! Every day is an adventure.
It is morning. Pip wakes up. "Good morning!"
Pip brushes his teeth. Scrub, scrub, scrub!
Pip puts on his backpack and walks to school.
At recess, Pip plays with his friends. He runs and slides!
At night, Pip reads his favorite book.
Then he closes his eyes and sleeps. Good night, Pip!
Look at the word "cap." Short a, like in apple.
Now add a magic E to the end: "cape"! The A says its own name!
Leo has a new kite. He hopes it will fly high.
Leo runs across the playground with his kite.
The kite flies up, up, up! Leo is so happy.
"I hope we fly my kite again tomorrow!" says Leo.
Which word has the magic E sound?
You did it! You can talk about your whole day, and you read words with the magic E! Tonight, tell your family what you do every morning — and try reading a magic-E word together!
Hi! I am Pip. Do you know all the days of the week?
Every day is different! Let’s look at my whole week together.
On Monday, I go to school.
On Wednesday, I reed a new book.
On Thursday, I visit my friend Leo.
On Friday, I am so happy — the weekend is close!
On Saturday, I fly my kite all day.
On Sunday, I rest at home with my family.
Pip, what do you always do in the morning?
I always wake up and brush my teeth!
What do you usually do after school?
I usually play with my friends.
Yes! I sometimes eat pizza on Friday.
Do you ever go to school on Sunday?
No! I never go to school on Sunday. It is the weekend!
Which word means every single day — 100% of the time?
How often do you wake up early?
How often do you brush your teeth?
How often do you reed before bed?
How often do you play soccer on Saturday?
I sometimes play soccer on Saturday.
How often do you go to school on Sunday?
I never go to school on Sunday!
No school today! Which day is part of the weekend?
How often do you play outside?
How often do you reed a book?
Great! Every week is a fun week.
On Monday, Pip walks to school. He always says hello to his friends.
On Tuesday, Pip plays soccer with Leo. He usually wins!
On Wednesday, Pip reads a new book. He loves story time.
On Thursday, Pip visits Leo. They laugh and play together.
On Friday, Pip is very happy — pizza night! Tomorrow is Saturday.
On Saturday, Pip flies his kite all afternoon. No school today!
On Sunday, Pip rests at home with his family. Good night, week!
Look at the word “day.” Two letters, A and Y, together make one long A sound!
Listen: day! Now try “play” and “stay” — they have the same sound!
It is Saturday. Mia wants to play all day.
“Let’s stay outside and play!” says Mia.
Mia and her friends play and play. What a fun day!
“I hope every day can be like today!” says Mia.
Which word has the same sound as “day”?
You did it! You know the days of the week, and you can say how often you do things! Tonight, tell your family what you always do every week — and try reading an “ay” word together!
Hi! Do you remember my day? Today I want to tell you about yesterday!
Yesterday is a day that already happened. Let’s remember it together!
Pip, what did you do yesterday morning?
Yesterday, I woke up and I brushed my teeth!
Yes! I walked to school, and I played with my friends.
What did you do at night?
I reed a book, and then I slept!
Which word means it already happened — yesterday?
“Woke up” — is this regular or irregular?
Great! Now you can talk about yesterday!
Yesterday morning, Pip woke up and stretched.
He brushed his teeth. Scrub, scrub, scrub!
He ate his breakfast. Yum, yum!
He walked to school with his backpack.
At recess, he played with Mia and Leo.
At night, he reed his favorite book.
Then he slept. What a busy yesterday!
Look at the word “see.” Two letters, E and E, together make one long E sound!
Listen: see! Now try “tree” and “sleep” — they have the same sound!
Leo sees a big, tall tree.
“I want to climb the tree!” says Leo.
Leo climbs up and looks at everything. What a great day!
After playing, Leo is tired. He wants to sleep.
Which word has the same sound as “see”?
You did it! You can talk about yesterday, and you know regular and irregular verbs! Tonight, tell your family what you did yesterday — and try reading an “ee” word together!
Whoa, look at this big door! I wonder what is behind it...
Let’s open it and explore together!
Hello! I am Wim. I am a wizard!
Meow! I am Cat-cat. I am a cat!
Where is Wim? He is in the kitchen!
Where is Cat-cat? She is in the living room!
Where is Wim? He is in the bathroom!
Where is Cat-cat? She is in the bedroom!
Where is Wim? He is in the dining room!
Where is Cat-cat? She is in the hallway!
There is a table in the kitchen!
There is a chair in the kitchen!
Cat-cat loves to hide! Today she hides in the kitchen.
There is a cat... under the table!
Wim looks everywhere. Is Cat-cat in his study?
There is a cat... on the windowsill!
Wim finds her at last! "There you are, Cat-cat!"
Oh no! Wim can’t find his magic wand. "Where is it?" he asks.
Pip looks in the great hall. "There is no wand here," says Pip.
Cat-cat looks by the window. "There is no wand here either!" says Cat-cat.
They look in the kitchen. "There it is! There is a wand on the table!" says Wim.
"Thank you, friends!" says Wim. Everyone is happy again.
Wim is a wizard. His magic spell is "Chip, chop, cheese!"
Wim is in the kitchen. There is a chair. There is a pot on the fire.
"Is it lunch? Is it cheese?" asks Cat-cat.
Wim waves his wand. "Chip, chop, cheese!" Chips pop out of the pot!
Wim, Cat-cat and Pip have lunch. Chomp, chomp! Cheers!
You explored the castle and learned kitchen, bedroom, table, and chair — and the magic ch sound! Look around your home tonight and say "There is a …!"
There is a chair in the dining room.
Pip! Come here! This is my favourite room in the castle.
A secret room? Open the door, Cat-cat!
There is a lamp in the bedroom!
There is a bed in the bedroom!
There is a window in the bedroom!
There is a window in the bedroom.
There is no bed in the bedroom.
Wow! There is a big bed!
And there is a window. I love this room!
Look, Pip! There is a little lamp in the bedroom.
There is a big window, and there is a wooden door.
Oh no! Where is the lamp? There is no lamp!
Wim waves his wand. "Wiggle, wobble, lamp come back!"
Look! The lamp is back. Well done, Wim!
You explored the bedroom and learned bed, lamp, door and window — and the magic L and W sounds! Tonight, look around your room and say "There is a …!"
Oh no! Where is my magic lamp? It is not on my desk!
Don’t worry, Wim. Let’s look for it together!
The lamp is on the table.
The lamp is next to the table.
The lamp is behind the table.
The lamp is in the box.
Put the lamp under the table.
Yes! The lamp is under the table.
Put the lamp in the box.
Yes! The lamp is in the box.
Put the lamp next to the table.
Yes! The lamp is next to the table.
Put the lamp on the table.
Yes! The lamp is on the table.
Put the lamp behind the table.
Yes! The lamp is behind the table.
It’s dark in here! Use the torch. Where is the lamp?
You found it! Where is the lamp?
The chair is next to the table.
The pot is in the fireplace.
The lamp is behind the chair.
No! It is not under the table.
Look! It is behind the bed!
Hmm… it is not under the table.
The picture is on the wall.
The books are in the bookcase.
The table is on the rug.
Oh no! My magic lamp is not on my desk. Where is it?
Look, Wim! The lamp is under the kitchen table!
Pop! Now the lamp is on a chair in the dining room.
Pop! Now it is in the bath! Silly lamp!
Pop! Now it is behind the bed. Got you, lamp!
Here it is! Thank you, Cat-cat! My magic lamp is back!

You found Wim’s magic lamp! You learned sofa, armchair, mirror, bookcase, clock and desk, and you can say where things are: in, on, under, next to and behind. Tonight, hide a toy and ask: "Where is it?"
